## Overview
Techmeme is a free, ad-supported news aggregator highlighting the latest news reports that tech industry leaders need to be aware of, placed alongside contrasting perspectives from social media and other outlets. It also provides custom aggregation services letting companies discover trending or carefully-filtered news in real time.
